title: WordPress VIP Integration Handoff Manifest
description: The single file a partner fills in so VIP can register and load their integration without reading the plugin source.

manifest_version.description: Manifest format version. Only "1" exists today.

manifest_kind.description: Fixed discriminator identifying this file as a handoff manifest.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across the Integration Center.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the Integration Center.

summary.description: One-line description shown on the catalog card.

support_contact.description: Email address or support URL VIP can reach the partner at.

documentation.description: Where VIP and customers find documentation for the integration.

folder.description: Plugin folder name VIP installs the integration into.

entry_file.description: Root plugin file (with the "Plugin Name:" header) VIP loads.

php_namespace.description: Root PHP namespace the plugin autoloads under.

scope.description: Whether the plugin loads per-site or network-wide.

constant_name.description: The VIP-defined config constant the plugin reads, e.g. VIP_ACME_CONFIG.

fields.description: The config fields the Integration Center renders and stores.

telemetry.description: VIP Tracks events the integration records. Omit this section entirely if it records none.

prefix.description: Event name prefix, ending in an underscore, e.g. acme_widget_.

default_properties.description: Property names attached to every event.

events.description: The individual Tracks events. Declares names only, never captured values.

release.description: Metadata about the submitted plugin version.

plugin_version.description: Semantic version matching the plugin header.

version_strategy.description: Release strategy identifier, e.g. latest or semantic_versioning.

migration_required.description: Whether this release requires migration work.

changelog.description: Short description of what this release contains.

key.description: snake_case key this value is stored under in the config array.

label.description: Field label shown in the Integration Center form.

type.description: Input type. Use "secret" for values VIP must encrypt at rest.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled before the integration can activate.

help.description: Optional helper text shown under the field.

default.description: Optional default value pre-filled in the form.

autogen.description: Whether the field is autogenerated and not editable by the customer.

note.description: Optional note on the field's purpose or usage. For internal use.

name.description: Full event name, including the telemetry prefix.

type.description: Telemetry channel. VIP integrations use Tracks only.

trigger.description: What causes the event to fire.

properties.description: Property names recorded with the event (names only, no values).

note.description: Optional note on why the event exists.
